aim.text: fm-proxy lets any ordinary OpenAI Chat Completions client use Apple's on-device Foundation Model (fm serve, model 'system') on macOS 27 without code changes, by correcting fm serve's deviations from the OpenAI spec on a loopback-only proxy, for local research only (licence conflict acknowledged).

As an OpenAI-SDK client, I can get a single JSON chat completion with accurate token usage from the on-device model, in order to use Apple's model without code changes. [api: POST /v1/chat/completions non-stream]

As an OpenAI-SDK client, I can stream a chat completion as SSE ending in exactly one finish_reason and real usage, in order to render output incrementally and account for tokens. [api: POST /v1/chat/completions stream]

As an OpenAI-SDK client, I can force a tool call (tool_choice required or named) and receive real tool_calls, streaming or not, in order to drive function calling despite fm serve's broken tool parser. [api: forced dispatch]

As an OpenAI-SDK client, I can send structured-output schemas generated by pydantic/zod/TypeBox ($defs/$ref, nullable type arrays) and get constrained JSON, in order to use structured output unmodified. [api: response_format]
As an OpenAI-SDK client, I can send tools with rich nested schemas and optional descriptions without the whole request 400ing, in order to reuse my existing tool definitions. [api: tools]

As an OpenAI-SDK client, I receive typed OpenAI-shaped errors (content_filter, context_length_exceeded, rate_limit_exceeded, invalid_request_error, cyclic_schema, upstream_unreachable) and transient failures are retried invisibly, in order to branch on cause instead of parsing Apple prose. [api: errors]
As an OpenAI-SDK client, my max_tokens, stop and developer-role fields are honoured, in order that standard request parameters behave per the OpenAI spec. [api: param fixups]
As an operator, my fm serve is protected from a cyclic $defs schema that would hang it permanently, in order to keep the server alive. [api: cyclic guard]
As a browser-based client, I can call the proxy cross-origin, in order to use the model from a web page. [api: CORS, header scrubbing]
As an OpenAI-SDK client, I can list models and check health, in order to discover the 'system' model and liveness. [api: GET /v1/models, /health]

As a client consuming content, I can opt in to stripping leaked chat-template markers, in order to get clean text while audits can still see the upstream bug by default. [env: FM_STRIP_TEMPLATE_MARKERS]
As an operator, I can start and stop fm serve plus the proxy with one command and configure ports, binary and retries, in order to run the stack without orphaned processes. [cli: fm-launch.sh, env]

As a maintainer, I can verify the proxy against a live fm serve, record a deterministic wire baseline, run unit/integration tests, and regenerate the fm CLI reference per build, in order to audit each macOS build and refactor safely. [cli: deviation-probe, wire-baseline, node --test, gen-fm-docs]
